description_en: Queries the details of enterprise travel rules, including categories such as flights, international flights, train tickets, and hotels
description_zh: 查询企业差旅规则详情（包括机票、国际机票、火车票、酒店等类目）
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen travel-standard-query --from-group false --rule-code 2006523763 --service-type-list flight --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TravelStandardQuery

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the group travel standard
parameters.name: from_group

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the enterprise access credential operation. Add this parameter to the request header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
